text: The doctors and all the staff are the most lovely, warm, and friendly, as if we were family. They provide advice, problem resolution, and understanding of the products and needs of customers. Most importantly, they inquire and follow up on customer satisfaction and concerns. In short, it's very good, from a customer who has actually received service here.

I went to get a pimple injection, and it was incredibly painful. They squeezed the pimple without any tools, leaving my skin severely bruised. After the injection, even though it was bleeding, they didn't provide any cotton swabs or bandages. I was very dissatisfied, and it wasn't even a doctor who did it. It's a truly traumatic experience, and I'll never go back there again.
